blockingFindings.description: Direct review of all five views shows severe faceting/rippling across jacket and waist/hip surfaces, strongest in rear and side views. This remains visually broken shading/geometry. The V106 authored pleat audit reports sub-millimeter radial displacement (per panel maxima below 0.8 mm), so that fold field alone does not explain the large visible surface distortion.
The outfit still renders almost entirely plain white; the narrow lavender sash and piping do not read as a lilac lamé fencing practice set.

Crouch, sit and prone show unnatural skirt/underlayer bunching, intersection and flare. Fit, final weights, shape-key response, UV validation, Unity/VRChat runtime and package eligibility remain unverified.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
